analysis_plan.de_method: edgeR quasi-likelihood negative-binomial model; robust dispersion and QL fitting
analysis_plan.discovery_contrast: ICC13-7, 75 nM futibatinib 24 h versus DMSO, n=3+3
analysis_plan.gene_universe: HGNC-mapped genes with a family annotation that pass edgeR filterByExpr in all three contrasts
analysis_plan.limitations: Two PDX models with three replicates per arm provide an application case, not general proof of algorithm superiority. No PDX information is used to construct rankings.

methods.Degree-only: Discovery direction combined with weighted hierarchy-graph degree rank; hub control
methods.Direct DE: Signed edgeR quasi-likelihood statistic in the discovery contrast
methods.Expression correlation: Direct discovery statistic mixed with propagation over a positive Pearson-expression graph
methods.Family-only: Direct discovery statistic mixed with propagation over row-normalized A A^T
methods.Hierarchy: Direct discovery statistic mixed with propagation over row-normalized A K A^T
methods.Random: Uniform random ranking summarized over 2,000 fixed-seed permutations

analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: Number of same-direction validation DE genes among the top 50 recommendations
analysis_plan.response_definition: FDR <= 0.05 and absolute log2 fold change >= 1 in a validation PDX
secondary_endpoints: average precision across the complete ranking
genes responding in the same direction in both PDX models
rank stability under prespecified hierarchy parameter changes
analysis_plan.status: Frozen before the new baseline outcomes were computed

validation_contrasts.MG212: PDX MG212, pemigatinib 11 d versus vehicle, n=3+3
validation_contrasts.MG69: PDX MG69, futibatinib 14 d versus vehicle, n=3+3
